name: Don Brown
incumbencyStatus: first-time Senate candidate (ran in 2024 NC-08 Congressional primary, lost)

biography.currentRole: Defense attorney, author, small business owner
priorRoles: Retired U.S. Navy JAG (Judge Advocate General) officer
biography.background: Born Plymouth, NC. Retired Navy JAG officer and Special Assistant U.S. Attorney. Defense attorney who represented defendants charged in connection with the January 6, 2021 Capitol riot. Author of 16 books. Ran in 2024 NC-08 Congressional primary and lost. Polling at ~7.5% in Feb 2026 GOP primary behind Trump-endorsed Michael Whatley. Raised $187,237 as of Feb 11, 2026 with ~$24,000 cash on hand.

statedPositions.quote: Americans should not be arrested for exercising our clear 2nd Amendment Rights to bear arms without restriction
statedPositions.notes: Supports National Constitutional Carry. Opposes all gun regulations.

statedPositions.quote: Proposed 'Vax and Mask Freedom Act' to ban vaccine and mask mandates federally
statedPositions.notes: Backed by personal litigation record — represented Savannah River Site nuclear engineers and other workers against COVID mandates.

statedPositions.quote: Eliminate the IRS, eliminate the federal income tax, and go to a Fair Tax system ... supplement the rest of revenue with tariffs
statedPositions.notes: FairTax = national consumption/sales tax replacing income, payroll, corporate, and estate taxes.

statedPositions.quote: Restoring fiscal sanity and attacking the $38 trillion national debt
statedPositions.notes: Core campaign message is reducing federal spending, cutting government bureaucracy. No support for expanding safety net programs.

statedPositions.quote: Protecting small businesses from regulatory strangulation
statedPositions.notes: Deregulation as primary economic tool. Proposed routing disaster relief through private charities (Samaritan's Purse) rather than federal agencies.

statedPositions.quote: Does not see an 'affordability crisis' in healthcare. Supports sending money directly to the people to pay for their healthcare, as President Trump is planning to do
statedPositions.notes: HSA/individual-account framing. No support for ACA, public option, or Medicare expansion.

statedPositions.quote: Called for National Guard on every Charlotte train. Attacked Roy Cooper for releasing pandemic-era inmates as 'soft on crime'
statedPositions.notes: Supports aggressive Border Patrol enforcement. Strong law-and-order positioning.

statedPositions.quote: Proposed eliminating property taxes for first-time homebuyers
statedPositions.notes: Deregulation to lower housing costs. No subsidies, no rent control.

statedPositions.quote: Unborn babies must be afforded the same constitutional rights to due process as all Americans, from the moment of conception
statedPositions.notes: Conception-at-personhood position (total ban framing). Outside scored axes but relevant context.

statedPositions.quote: Supported federal death penalty for fentanyl traffickers and child sex traffickers
statedPositions.notes: Attacked opponents as soft on crime. No direct statement on mandatory minimums or rehabilitation programs.

votingRecord.notes: First-time candidate with no legislative voting record.

positionConflicts.conflict: 'Law and order' candidate who simultaneously defended J6 defendants — framed as 'patriot clients' and called their prosecutions 'illegal fedsurrection'

positionConflicts.conflict: Fiscal hawk on national debt who wants dedicated Hurricane Helene trust fund
positionConflicts.resolution: Resolved via private/faith-based channel (Samaritan's Purse) rather than federal agency

evidenceSummary.notes: Don Brown has relatively detailed policy positions on his campaign website and in interviews, giving medium-to-high confidence on economic, justice, and health axes. Climate and housing/transport axes have no evidence. His endorsement profile (Robinson, Flynn, Powell) and J6 defense work position him firmly in the MAGA wing of the Republican Party.
